channel.title: SuperRobots — China Robotics News
channel.description: English summaries of Chinese robotics news and primary sources.

item.title: XPENG sets a 2027 retail training timetable for its IRON humanoid
item.description: XPENG says IRON will begin training as a store assistant in early 2027, with a public release targeted for the second quarter. Original source: XPENG (https://www.xpeng.com/pressroom/news/01a212b0d830a1e838d68a02a2110174).

item.title: ROBOTERA reports humanoid deployments at 11 Guangdong postal hubs
item.description: The robot maker says its China Post deployment now spans eleven hubs in eight cities, following a pilot in Guangzhou. Original source: ROBOTERA via PR Newswire (https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/robotera-expands-humanoid-robot-deployment-across-china-posts-guangdong-network-reaching-eight-cities-province-wide-302941879.html).

item.title: Chengdu unveils a Gongga humanoid designed to replan household tasks
item.description: The fifth-generation Gongga is designed to remember where objects were, predict the results of a move, and revise its plan when its surroundings change. Original source: Sichuan Online (https://sichuan.scol.com.cn/ggxw/202611/83355185.html).

item.title: Yongda Auto agrees to buy 400 UBTECH humanoids
item.description: The companies plan to use the U1 Pro for product demonstrations, sales promotion, and customer service, with delivery targeted by the end of 2026. Original source: The Paper (https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_34455328).

item.title: Beijing plans real-world tests for embodied AI robots
item.description: The city's 2026–2028 plan calls for a shared test site and aims to collect more than one million hours of robotics data across at least 100 real-world settings. Original source: Beijing Municipal Government (https://www.beijing.gov.cn/zhengce/gfxwj/202611/t20261111_4942067.html).

item.title: Joyson delivers its first robot compute backpack to Unitree
item.description: The add-on combines a computer and power system so robots can process sensor data and run AI models locally. Original source: Joyson Electronics (https://www.joyson.com/index.php/news/info/1448.html).

item.title: AgiBot X2 robots take visitor-service roles in Chengdu
item.description: Three X2 humanoids serve visitors at Kuanzhai Alley, with roles spanning welcome desks, cultural interpretation, and retail. Original source: AgiBot (https://www.agibot.com.cn/article/315/detail/252.html).

item.title: X2 joins a hospital reception desk with Ant Afu
item.description: AgiBot reports a hospital deployment that answers visitor questions and helps people navigate outpatient services. Original source: AgiBot (https://www.agibot.com.cn/article/315/detail/248.html).

item.title: AgiBot outlines a university robotics training program
item.description: The company plans more than 1,000 robots and software access for hands-on teaching and research at Chinese universities. Original source: AgiBot (https://www.agibot.com.cn/article/315/detail/247.html).

item.title: Humanoid robots take the stage in Guangzhou
item.description: A National Day show puts coordinated humanoid performances and public interaction in the spotlight at the Guangdong Science Center. Original source: China Youth Daily / Sina (https://finance.sina.com.cn/jjxw/2026-10-02/doc-initusmm4796722.shtml).

item.title: AgiBot’s A3 gets a native NetEase Cloud Music integration
item.description: Voice-controlled music is scheduled to reach the full-size humanoid on October 15. Music-generated movement remains a development goal. Original source: AgiBot (https://www.agibot.com.cn/article/315/detail/236.html).

item.title: More than 300 robots join the everyday life of a theme park
item.description: AgiBot and Chimelong put robots to work across performances, visitor guidance, education, retail, and hospitality in Hengqin. Original source: AgiBot (https://www.agibot.com.cn/article/315/detail/231.html).

item.title: Unitree releases its humanoid base model and fine-tuning code
item.description: The Chinese project README records a September 28 release of UnifoLM-WLA-1.0-Base and tools for adapting the model. Original source: Unitree · Chinese project README (https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unifolm-wla/blob/main/README_zh.md).

item.title: A wheeled tennis robot meets Wang Qiang on court
item.description: LimX Dynamics and Enhance pair a TRON 2 mobile platform with a tennis-training system at the Billie Jean King Cup finals. Original source: LimX Dynamics (https://www.limxdynamics.com/zh/news/BK000125).

item.title: Unitree’s G1+ adds stronger joints and richer sensing
item.description: The upgraded humanoid brings a two-axis neck, stereo and wide-angle vision, touch sensing, and external power support. Original source: Shangguan News / Sina (https://finance.sina.com.cn/jjxw/2026-09-22/doc-inistewv6764719.shtml).

item.title: D-Robotics raises $400 million for robot chips and development tools
item.description: The Series C round backs Sunrise chips and a software platform spanning data collection, training, simulation, and deployment. Original source: Shenzhen News (https://www.sznews.com/news/content/2026-09/17/content_32173727.htm).
